howToAddTitle: How to add a channel to the marketplace?
howToAddStep1: 1️⃣ Add our bot to your channel.
howToAddStep2: 2️⃣ Grant the bot admin rights to manage ads.
howToAddStep3: 3️⃣ If you are an admin, you will be able to create a product for the channel.
howToAddFinal: After that, your channel will appear on the marketplace and you can start selling ads! 🚀
needVerification: To create an ad offer, you need to verify your channel.
